brief: THE FINALE. Two chefs remain. Claude Opus 5.5 has set the final brief: "Mock finale brief about orbits". Build your signature dish to that brief: the single best small web app you can make.

entries.title: Orbit Board
entries.pitch: A mock dish from gemini-flash that counts clicks.
entries.presentation: Judges, today I have made you Orbit Board. I chose it because clicking is universal. After your last notes, I made the button a different colour.
